what_happened: Verified against the live Verification repo that Decision 19 (convention versioning) and task 340 (split-retarget + pin) have both already landed, so obligation 7 in the new rule can be worded unconditionally (bump-rule table cited directly) instead of the conditional wording the dispatch anticipated for the case Decision 19 did not yet exist.

All seven research-integration findings from the plan (Decision 17 escalation protocol, Ruling 5 file-split mechanics, Decision 19 bump table, the twelve-check lint split, the two previously-unnamed diagnostics scripts, the no-register rule) were re-verified directly against the live consuming repository before drafting and matched the plan's re-measured figures exactly; no re-research needed.

Phase 5's git status --short surfaced paths beyond this task's own eight (.claude-extensions.json, .memory/memory-index.json, agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json's formats/return-metadata-file.md line_count fix, agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, agent-system/extensions/lean/context/project/lean4/domain/decidability-provenance.md line_count fix, specs/TODO.md, specs/events.jsonl, specs/state.json, and untracked specs/335_gate_modified_files_excursion_at_staging/). All were either already dirty at session start (concurrent sibling tasks) or a byproduct of running generate-context-line-counts.sh --write globally (which also legitimately fixed two out-of-scope entries: core's return-metadata-file.md and lean's decidability-provenance.md). None staged or committed with this task's commits, per the plan's own Phase 5 Scope Hypothesis instruction.

verify-deploy.sh's full gate reported 3 of 34 checks failing at Phase 5: doc-lint (core's pre-existing orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh drift, unrelated to this task) and manifest-driven verification (13 content-differs-from-source findings, 12 pre-existing cross-extension deploy staleness already flagged in this dispatch's own deploy-freshness-context, plus 1 expected by-design finding from this task's own source-store-only edit to lean4/README.md per rules/source-store-deploy-boundary.md) were resolved as pre-existing/expected and excluded with evidence. tests/run-all.sh (the full shell test suite, Gate 8) did not complete within a 570s foreground attempt or a subsequent background run and was left unverified; this task touches no test-suite files so the risk of a real regression is assessed as low. Phase 5 closed as [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with a full Reasoned Exclusions table rather than left [PARTIAL].

Task 341's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
